lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

candidates.title: Spotlight Pet Selector Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen into a spotlight layout with animated pet previews and distinct trait badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a 89s median time, while support emails cite confusion and bugs during pet selection.

guard.reason: Uses 'Most Popular' badge to pressure or influence the user's choice

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Notice
candidates.change: Add a clear account sync hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent losing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to retrieve your existing pets and settings.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync hint to the sign-in screen helps returning users without violating any onboarding restrictions.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume (8) and straightforward hint configuration fix.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen at the end of onboarding displaying visual quick-reference cards for controlling, hiding, and interacting with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.

new_controls_overview.headline: How to Control Your Companion
new_controls_overview.body: Right-click your pet anywhere on the screen to open quick actions, manage visibility, or trigger pet chat.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls overview screen after home_intro is allowed as part of onboarding expansion.

candidates.score_note: Requires creating a new screen; moderate support complaints about post-onboarding controls.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Check Wait Screen
candidates.change: Enhance the waiting screen with progress indicators, time estimates, and display permission guidance while desktop pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Home target step has high drop-off and very long average wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s), plus 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Debut...
waiting.body: We are setting up your pet's desktop overlay. Please ensure screen draw permissions are enabled if prompted.

guard.reason: Enhancing the waiting screen with progress indicators and permission guidance maintains its core job of indicating pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses severe 2336s mean duration drop-off supported by emails.

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Starter Path
candidates.change: Redesign the intro story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring animated mascot assets and clear path entry points.
candidates.why: The choose_path target step has a 514s mean duration, indicating users stall or get distracted before selecting a path.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Scroll down to discover your pet's origins and choose how you want to get started.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story intro screen to a scrollable layout with mascot assets retains its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: High implementation effort for redesigns, which have shown weak performance in past tests.

candidates.title: Certificate Naming and Customization Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen into a split layout flow with custom pet name input and an official adoption stamp component.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s).

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a custom name to seal the adoption certificate.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Sign-In Card Layout with Troubleshooting Hint
candidates.change: Reframe the sign-in screen into a structured card layout with step counters and a troubleshooting hint for frozen login prompts.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a high mean time of 567s, and 2 support emails noted sign-in screens stalling or missing.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Progress
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save your companion and access them across devices.
sign_in.hint: Window slow to respond? Ensure popup blockers are disabled or choose another provider.

guard.reason: Reframing sign-in into a card layout with troubleshooting advice retains sign-in functionality and complies with onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Tackles sign-in stalling with modest support evidence and layout adjustments.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring a live mascot celebration animation and companion setup checklist.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion sits at 64.8%, and overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your new pet is now live on your screen.

components.text: Desktop overlay active; Interactions ready; Save file synced

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro into a stage showcase layout is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Costly animation redesign targeting finish drop-off without support email backing.

candidates.title: Path Selection Guided Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Convert the choose_path screen into a checklist layout with a visible step counter to make decision-making immediate.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has a huge difference between median (8s) and mean (514s) time, showing extreme user paralysis.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to set up your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Updating the path selection layout and text retains the core function of letting the user choose their pet setup path.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme mean time paralysis at choose_path via structured UI layout.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Add a notify-when-ready option and rotating tip carousel to the waiting screen while background companion setup finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting phase in home step takes a very long mean time (2336s), causing users to leave the desktop app unattended.

components.text: Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on your desktop once loaded.

guard.reason: Adding a notification opt-in and tips carousel to the waiting screen preserves its function while adding useful background context.

candidates.score_note: Effective pattern for retaining users during exceptionally long wait periods.

picked: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen

decisions.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption, redesign, finish, and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed for each kind of change.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.
